d: Part of the OHI Group, IITC delivers enterprise technology and digital solutions that help organisations improve performance, modernise operations, and achieve their business objectives.
IITC welcomes applications from experienced Omani professionals for the position of Application Project Manager.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise IT and application projects across the full project lifecycle, from planning and implementation through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live, handover, and closure..

We are looking for a collaborative and customer-focused professional who can manage complexity, build strong stakeholder relationships, and drive successful project delivery with clarity and accountability.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering , or a related discipline.
5-10 years of experience managing IT and application projects.
Strong experience in customer-facing project management.
Good knowledge of Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and presentation skills.
Experience using Microsoft Project, Jira , or Azure DevOps is an advantage.
Previous project delivery experience in Oman or the Middle East is preferred.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE IN ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWING AREAS

We welcome applications from experienced professionals who enjoy leading complex projects, collaborating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and turning project plans into successful business outcomes.
📩 Ready to take the next step in your project management career? Apply now and grow with IITC.
r: li
Manage IT and application projects from initiation and planning through implementation, UAT, go-live, handover, and closure.
li
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests.
li
Coordinate closely with customers, business stakeholders, technical teams, application vendors, and third-party service providers.
li
Lead requirements coordination, application implementation, system integration, testing, migration, and deployment activities.
li
Maintain project plans, RAID logs, progress reports, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
li
Conduct regular project reviews with customers and management.
li
Proactively manage project risks, escalations, and delivery dependencies.
li
Ensure timely completion, customer acceptance, smooth handover, and formal project closure.

d: F&B Growth & Commercial Strategy | Kuwait | Full-time

A restaurant management company in Kuwait is seeking a commercially driven Marketing Manager to lead the marketing function across its multi-brand restaurant portfolio. The ideal candidate will turn marketing investment into measurable customer growth, stronger sales performance and improved contribution profit.

You will own multi-brand marketing strategy, growth planning and execution. You will partner with Operations, Finance, Cost Control and Supply Chain to drive sustainable growth across dine-in, direct ordering and third-party delivery channels.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related discipline; an MBA or postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Minimum 8 years of progressive marketing experience, including at least 5 years in F&B / restaurant marketing.
Minimum 3 years in a marketing management or leadership role with responsibility for teams, budgets and commercial outcomes.
Proven experience managing marketing across multiple restaurant brands or branches.
Demonstrable achievements in revenue growth, direct-channel development, customer retention and marketing ROI.
Strong knowledge of Kuwait’s restaurant market, delivery aggregators, digital ordering and customer behavior.
Financial literacy covering contribution margin, promotional economics, pricing and sales analysis.
Hands-on familiarity with CRM, loyalty tools, performance marketing, reporting dashboards and analytics.
Professional working proficiency in Arabic and English.

Evidence of growing direct sales, improving restaurant or branch performance, building profitable loyalty programs, managing aggregator exposure and delivering measurable improvements in revenue or contribution profit. Experience in Kuwait is an advantage.
r: li
Develop annual, quarterly and 90-day marketing plans tied to brand- and branch-level sales performance.
li
Increase profitable sales across dine-in, direct delivery and digital ordering while optimizing aggregator channel economics.
li
Build CRM, loyalty, customer segmentation, consent-based WhatsApp engagement and repeat-purchase programs.
li
Evaluate aggregator promotions, commissions, discounts, advertising investments, conversion and channel contribution.
li
Work with Finance and Operations on pricing, campaign profitability, menu engineering, average ticket and customer experience.
li
Design local-store marketing initiatives, corporate partnerships, neighborhood activations and underperforming-branch recovery campaigns.
li
Lead brand positioning, performance advertising, product launches, digital content and customer acquisition campaigns.
li
Manage marketing budgets, external partners and the marketing team; report KPIs, insights and improvement actions to leadership.
li
Coordinate campaigns and product launches in accordance with the company’s established Finance, Operations and Supply Chain approval procedures.
